glossary.力量: 每层力量通常使攻击额外造成 1 点伤害。
glossary.易伤: 易伤单位会承受更多攻击伤害。
glossary.格挡: 格挡会优先抵消即将受到的伤害。
glossary.消耗: 消耗牌打出后会移出本场战斗。
glossary.附魔: 附魔是卡牌附着的额外词条或效果层。

runPlan.archetype: Strength + AOE frontload; survive first, close 40 dmg/turn gap
runPlan.bossPrep: Enter as healthy as possible with both potions; turns 1-2 no debuffs: powers and burst, then kill the Torch Head Amalgam first; strength growth for 690 HP.
runPlan.summary: HP is critical at 19%: conserve, rest to heal, skip optional elites, draft block then strength/AOE. Spend 376 gold on potions and power cards. Close the 40/turn boss gap.
